<!-- SOURCE_TURN_004_BEGIN -->
Sure, here are some example links you can use for the friend pictures:

* <https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/FF0000/FFFFFF>
* <https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/00FF00/FFFFFF>
* <https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/0000FF/FFFFFF>
* <https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/FFFF00/FFFFFF>
* <https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/FF00FF/FFFFFF>

These links will generate 100x100 pixel images with different background colors. You can use them in the "img" tag for each friend, like this:
```php
<ul>
  <li><img src="https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/FF0000/FFFFFF" alt="Friend 1"></li>
  <li><img src="https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/00FF00/FFFFFF" alt="Friend 2"></li
```
<!-- SOURCE_TURN_004_END -->
